svg.text: Triggered async by WF2 after every VAPI call ends.
No response required — fire and forget.
2. ✅ Validate: halt if no phone number extracted
3. Read Clients tab by phone number
4. Read Appointment Log for confirmed booking
5. Read Messages for any urgent notes
6. Build update payload (CRM + SMS + activity log
7b. Update Clients tab in Google Sheets
8a. If urgent message → SMS alert to business
8b. Route by outcome → SMS to caller
- Add Twilio credentials to the 4 Twilio SMS nodes
- Create Activity Log tab in Google Sheets:
Columns: Timestamp | Phone | Call ID | Outcome |
Duration (s) | SMS Queued | Config Ready | Error…
Extracts: phone, caller name, outcome, duration, transcript URL.
Then reads Sheets context (client record, booking, messages).
Updates Clients tab with: Status, Last Outcome, Last Contact,
Call Count, Upcoming Appointment, Transcript URL.
Three parallel branches from Update Client Record:
If caller left urgent message → SMS internal alert to business owner.
- booked → booking confirmation SMS (with date, time, address if available)
- voicemail → when's a good time? SMS
- called / not-interested / do-not-contact → no outcome SMS
If caller left any message AND outcome is not booked → SMS to caller confirming message
received. (Booked callers already get a full confirmation SMS.)
⚠️ Set twilioFromNumber + businessOwnerPhone in Client Config.
Phone check: Workflow halts with clear error if
VAPI payload has no phone number.
Config check: Activity Log shows Config Ready=N if
Twilio placeholders not yet replaced. Twilio node…
